welcome:
Welcome to the experiment.

You will complete two rooms. In each room, you will see a sequence of images, each associated with a reward value. After each room, your memory for the images will be tested.

Please pay close attention throughout.

Press NEXT to continue.
version_simple_intro:
In each room, you will see a sequence of images.
Each image is associated with a reward value.
Your job is to pay attention to both the images and the reward values as the sequence unfolds.
Some parts of the sequence may feel more continuous, while others may change more abruptly.
Please pay close attention throughout the room, because your memory for the images will be tested afterward.

Press NEXT to continue.
version_rich_intro:
In each room, you will see a sequence of images.
Each image is associated with a reward value.
Your job is to pay attention to both the images and the reward values as the sequence unfolds.
Some parts of the sequence may feel more continuous, while others may change more abruptly.
Please pay close attention throughout the room, because your memory for the images will be tested afterward.

You will also see a blue progress bar near the bottom of the screen as the sequence unfolds.
You do not need to respond to it.

Press NEXT to continue.
block_no_boundary_intro:
In this room, reward values will vary across the sequence, but there will be no major shifts in the underlying reward pattern.
Please watch the sequence carefully and try to remember the images and how the sequence unfolded over time.

Press NEXT to begin.
block_boundary_intro:
In this room, reward values may sometimes shift more abruptly, indicating that the underlying reward pattern has changed.
Please continue paying attention to both the images and the reward values, and try to remember how the sequence unfolded.

Press NEXT to begin.
recognition_intro:
You will now see individual images.
For each one, decide whether it appeared earlier in this room.
Respond as quickly and accurately as possible.

Press NEXT to begin the test.
single_item_intro:
You will now see images from the sequence again.
For each image, place it where you think it appeared during the sequence in this room.
Click on the scale below the image to indicate its position.

Press NEXT to begin the test.
paired_item_intro:
You will now see two images from the sequence at the same time.
Place both images where you think they appeared during the sequence.
Use their positions to indicate both which image came earlier and how far apart they were.

Press NEXT to begin the test.
break_text:
You have finished this room.
Please take a short break if you like.

Press NEXT when you are ready to continue.
end_text:
You have completed the experiment.
Thank you for your participation!

Your data has been saved.
